instruction: Enable automatic timezone detection based on my current location.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic timezone detection via GNOME settings. The setup disables automatic-timezone, and the agent must enable it using gsettings command. The evaluator verifies the setting is enabled by reading the gsettings value.
metadata.verification: The evaluator uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Expected output is 'true\n' when the setting is enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.datetime automatic-timezone' which correctly reads the automatic timezone setting
Metric logic is correct: exact_match performs string comparison which is appropriate for gsettings output
Expected value is correct: 'true\n' matches the actual gsettings output format when the setting is enabled (includes trailing newline)
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction - enabling automatic timezone detection
Data flow is sound: Setup disables setting -> Agent enables it -> Evaluator reads and verifies it's true
